data.long_meaning: The name Hubba is derived from the Arabic word 'hubb' which means 'love'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the deep affection and love that a mother has for her child. The name Hubba carries the meaning “Beloved, Affectionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hubba usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, affectionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
